review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; independent failure evidence from pane %80
review.decision: Keep unverified acceptance out of input admission and make an already written delivery audit idempotent
review.notes: Independent review reproduced both failures using synthetic HOME and a fake driver. Preserve receiver identity when the observation window is full or expires.

cases.description: Unverified acceptance history at capacity does not block later independent admissions
cases.setup: Fill the active proof window with old but valid synthetic receiver acknowledgements from a retired Home, and prepare two new independent wakes.
cases.action: Accept a fresh batch at capacity, then observe past expiry and drain the independent later wake.
cases.expected: One submission per fresh batch, no replays or lost acknowledgement. Full or expired active proofs are retained with exact receipt provenance in a bounded private archive and independently discoverable.

cases.description: A crash after the durable delivery audit cannot recount the same batch
cases.setup: Retain the same accepted-wake receipt and exact transcript proof as if cleanup was interrupted after append.
cases.action: Confirm the receipt twice while keeping the append result and original stable op ID across simulated restart.
cases.expected: One durable delivery audit for this batch, with no input mutation. Clean up the retained receipt only after observing the matching audit.
